## Problem and result

What concrete problem does this solve, and what changes for the user?
Link any related issue.

## Scope and contracts

State the authorized phase/scope and any ADR, migration or documentation impact.
Explain effects on target ownership, credentials, evidence or uncertainty when relevant.

## Verification

List commands actually run and observed results. Name unrun checks and limitations.
For behavior changes, link rerunnable regressions and relevant real-infrastructure evidence.
Redact secrets and private target details from every attachment.

## Review checks

- [ ] The change stays within its stated phase/scope; it adds no future-phase implementation.
- [ ] Behavior and documentation agree; architectural changes have the required ADR record.
- [ ] Verification claims reflect observed results; no evidence or metrics are fabricated.
- [ ] No secrets, unintended generated artifacts or machine-specific configuration are included.

Security vulnerabilities belong in the repository's [private reporting channel](https://github.com/Shehroz61/RuptureGrid/security/policy), not this public pull request.
